request_accounting: count every inference attempt before dispatch, including failed requests, retries, SDK automatic retries; disable unbounded hidden retries; stop at either approved bound
cost_gate: compute conservative maximum input/output/question/image and retry fees using official billing rules; if no finite upper bound is available do not send
metrics: HTTP/API successful requests / all attempts; refusal, timeout, retry, rate-limit counts separately
finite-answer deviation / received answers; missing, duplicate, extra IDs separately
valid decision coverage / intended questions; unresolved / valid answers separately
agreement / valid normal-or-effect comparisons, raw denominator and unresolved/failed counts; also full eligible denominator
Normal→effect and effect→Normal counts; per-reference-class denominators; tuning and held-out separately
Japanese behavior review with original scene context; sarcasm/double negation unverified stays missing
wall time of each request and complete preparation→validation→save separately; request count and batch questions explicit
official usage as returned, not estimated from bytes; documented fee estimate distinguished from invoiced cost
probability/confidence only when formally present; no self-reported JSON score substituted for calibration
repeated frozen input consistency only if repeated; no general reproducibility claim from one response
batch/shared context efficiency only if documented and actually measured; do not divide batch latency into fictitious per-call latency
